coordinate_system: top-left within24x24 em; rows are native font pixels; offset=[x,y]; advance in same pixels

design.description: Quiet campus notebook ink: short square terminals, open counters and restrained one-cell stair curves. Latin uses16-cell caps/digits,12-cell x-height, proportional letters and tabular12-cell numerals; each is authored directly on the native grid rather than doubling a coarse bitmap. Original CJK construction is retained. No random notches, detached decorative dots, synthetic italic or borrowed font outlines.

provenance.authoring: Original glyph construction authored for the7:55 project; conventional letter/character skeletons, independent pixel arrangements. No font outline/raster tracing or extraction was used for this file.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0 for these original project glyph sources; any font family combining them with OFL-derived glyphs must preserve the upstream OFL and accurately disclose the derivative boundary.
provenance.scope: This file covers printable ASCII and selected manually drawn CJK only. It does not claim an independently original full Chinese typeface.

8.construction: Small upper loop and broader lower loop, separated open counters and short waist.

9.construction: High round loop and open descending exit;9 has a longer right-side fall than6.
